clauses.title: Delay Liquidated Damages
clauses.terms: Supplier shall credit 1.5% of shipment invoice value per business day of unexcused delay, capped at 15.0% of order value.

clauses.title: Expedited Logistics Surcharge Sharing
clauses.terms: In the event of packaging or manufacturing delay originating with supplier, supplier shall reimburse up to 60% of expedited freight surcharges upon submission of carrier air waybill.

clauses.title: Emergency Allocation Commitment
clauses.terms: Supplier maintains a standing reserved production buffer of up to 600 units/month for rapid allocation within 72 hours of emergency purchase order issuance.

clauses.title: Emergency Procurement Premium
clauses.terms: Orders triggered under 72h lead time SLA are billed at base contract price plus a negotiated 10% emergency surcharge.

clauses.title: Secondary Spot Capacity Cap
clauses.terms: Supplier offers secondary supply allocation with maximum order quantity capped at 300 units per order and standard 6-day lead time.

clauses.title: Local Hub Delivery SLA
clauses.terms: Same-day or next-day dedicated road courier delivery for Munich Hub from Nuremberg facility; reliability guarantee 97%.
